name: Deploy docs on commits to main

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - docs/**
  # Allow manual triggering of the workflow
  workflow_dispatch:

# Set default permissions to none for security
permissions: {}

concurrency:
  # Cancel any running workflow when new commits are pushed to main.
  group: deploy-docs-on-commits-to-main
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # Detect if docs have changed
  paths-filter:
    name: Filter docs changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      docs_changed: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.docs }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Filter docs changes
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@de90cc6fb383172a1e8538b71d0010d56648101f # v3.0.2
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            docs:
              - 'docs/**'

  # Trigger Vercel deploy for website when docs change
  trigger-website-deploy:
    name: Trigger website deploy
    needs: paths-filter
    if: needs.paths-filter.outputs.docs_changed == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Trigger Vercel deploy hook
        run: |
          curl -X POST "${{ secrets.WEBSITE_VERCEL_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL }}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"ref": "main"}'
